title: Keep the LikeC4 system overview aligned with high-level topology
scope: Pull requests whose change can alter Agentic Workspace high-level System Overview topology: deployable applications/services, external systems, owned data/storage boundaries, or major service-to-service/event relationships.
applies_when: The reviewed change adds, removes, or changes at least one high-level topology fact represented by docs/architecture/.
violation: The high-level topology change is not reflected in the same pull request's LikeC4 model, or the changed model contradicts the implemented/documented topology.
non_violation: Editorial documentation changes, internal use-case/controller/handler refactors, implementation details inside an existing system boundary, and package/runtime dependency changes that do not alter System Overview topology do not require a LikeC4 update.
evidence: Cite the topology-changing repository location, the corresponding missing or contradictory node/relationship/data boundary in docs/architecture/, and the maintenance requirement in the canonical source.
